mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to historical averages compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, the Federal Reserve is likely to initiate a tightening cycle, causing a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, which typically precedes corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high housing starts (HOUST) and strong GDP growth (GDPC1), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as the economy approaches a peak; thus, high HOUST and GDPC1 predict negative forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime (HOUST > 900k and GDPC1 QoQ > 1.5%), S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates weakening labor market conditions, which typically leads to lower consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises by more than 0.2 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 (index 2017=100), it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically precedes a recession and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer and housing demand, which typically drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS increase and HOUST increase fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.0% triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%), S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%.
